name: uniprot
description: Per-endpoint map of UniProt data: per-protein .txt flat-file (live REST), per-organism reference-proteome .dat.gz (bulk), TSV column export, and cache row shapes. Use BEFORE building any UniProt scraper or choosing between bulk seed and per-protein live fetch. Documents the whole-human-proteome bulk seed, canonical download URLs, the merged type='uniprot' cache shape, and the bulk-vs-REST-vs-TSV supplier tradeoffs.
author: GuildOS
